description: This line plot illustrates the training loss trajectories for five different model architectures—ChemBART Small 20M, ChemBART Medium 20M, ChemBERTa Medium 20M, ChemLLaMA Small 20M, and ChemLLaMA Medium 20M—each trained on a dataset of 20 million samples. The x-axis represents the training step count, ranging from 0K to 440K, with labeled tick marks at intervals of 20K, 40K, 60K, 80K, and 420K, 430K, and 440K, indicating a linear scale in thousands of steps. The y-axis represents the training loss, scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.85. The plot displays five distinct lines: the red line (ChemBART Small 20M) starts at approximately 0.75 and decreases to around 0.12; the blue line (ChemBART Medium 20M) begins near 0.75 and settles at approximately 0.10; the green line (ChemBERTa Medium 20M) begins near 0.75 and stabilizes around 0.12; the purple line (ChemLLaMA Small 20M) starts near 0.75 and ends at approximately 0.08; and the brown line (ChemLLaMA Medium 20M) begins near 0.75 and concludes at approximately 0.08. All lines exhibit a rapid initial decline in loss, followed by a period of fluctuation before stabilizing at a low value. The green line appears to stabilize slightly higher than the others after 40K steps, while the blue and purple lines show the lowest final loss values.
